status: Compact stock-size pole candidate; cold result only, fluid trial queued
geometry: One10mm diameter x5mm SmCo disc per pole,4.2mm face gap,centreZ-3.2mm; same wider tip contacts/nozzle/pool. Nominal magnet assembly Yextent14.2mm instead24.2mm. Heater/mount envelope separate.

limitations: Midplane estimates integrate cell-centred J on the first nonnegative-x plane. The +/-2 mm mean includes the full interval even where a phase is absent; it is not a unique through-current.
Ideal electrical contact; material and oxide/contact resistance require bracketing.
Static liquid; no moving interface, motional EMF, self-field, driver, thermal evolution or droplet claim.
Applied magnetization and unit permeability approximate a specified magnet grade; check local field and temperature.
cold_report.status: cold DC conduction and applied permanent-magnet field only; no ejection simulation

driver_250A.method: Exact integrals of piecewise-linear prescribed current; V=IR+L dI/dt. Head modeled as constant cold resistance. Four-quadrant current regulation assumed.
limitations: No PWM ripple, switching/gate losses, current-loop dynamics, bus/lead ringing or protection design.
No capacitor ESR/ripple rating or switch SOA/temperature qualification.
Input R and L assumptions must be replaced with measured assembled values; motional voltage is omitted from this lumped check.
Electrical compliance is not a droplet or repetition-rate prediction.

limits: Full-domain subdivision4 evaluation exceeded the direct-source work budget and did not produce a cold solution.
Subdivision2 used for full-domain cold fields. Subdivision2/4 local-window B comparison changes meanfield about0.75%; does not bound the whole-volume force error.
The small sampling-window conduction currents/resistance/force are not device predictions; only its static B samples are used.
